title: Bean Sprout Soup
summary: Soybean sprouts simmered in anchovy stock, and nothing more. The fewer the ingredients, the more the cooking has to be right.
intro:
Bean sprout soup has only three ingredients, so there is nowhere to hide. Make the stock properly, and once the sprouts go in, do not lift the lid — that is the whole recipe.

The garlic goes in at the end so the broth does not turn cloudy.

items.name: Dried kelp (dasima / kombu)
items.amount: one 5 x 5 cm (2 x 2 in) piece

steps: Pull the heads and guts off the anchovies. Put the water, anchovies and kelp in a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Once it boils, lift out the kelp, boil for 7 minutes more, then take out the anchovies as well.
Rinse the soybean sprouts and pick off the loose husks.
Add the sprouts to the stock, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once it boils, turn the heat down to medium and leave it for 6 minutes. Do not lift the lid during this time.
Take off the lid and add the soup soy sauce. Taste and adjust with salt.
Add the diagonally sliced Korean leek and the minced garlic, boil for 1 minute more, then turn off the heat.
For a spicier bowl, add the chilli flakes at the very end.
tips: Opening and closing the lid partway through leaves a raw bean smell. Once it is covered, leave it alone for the full 6 minutes.
For a hangover soup, season with 1 tsp (5 mL) salted shrimp (saeu-jeot) and slice in one cheongyang chilli.
If you plan to spoon rice into it, season the broth slightly on the light side.
